{{Neutral}} [[Tazzo's Shack]] | affiliation = [[Tel Company]] | loc = [[South Seas]] }} '''Tel'Abim''' is an island in the [[South Seas]] off the eastern coast of [[Tanaris]]. Tel'Abim stands as the center for banana export, overseen by the neutral [[Tel Company]].
